cases.title: Practicing: the lesson opens by picking up what was still off, in plain words with how long ago, no skill ID

checks.detail: claude failed to run: spawnSync claude ETIMEDOUT

rubric.reason: The opening picks up the earlier work in one plain sentence with a sense of when and no skill ID or field name: "About a week and a half ago, you held one Blink pair while the others still faded", which matches the snapshot's 11 days and last attempt.

Blink, Cut, Opacity, Seal as a precomp, and the "three" and "one" counts all match the snapshot's candidates and left_out, and "the second pair" and the earlier held pair come from the learner's record.

The turn is short and moves one idea, whether Blink or Cut is meant to snap, with the memory and Seal lines as brief context; although the Seal note follows the question, "Is either one meant to snap instead of fade?" still leaves the learner something to answer.

The opening picks up the earlier work in one plain sentence with a sense of when, "About a week and a half ago, you held one Blink pair and the others still faded", which matches the 11 days and last attempt in the snapshot, then goes on with the lesson without naming a skill ID or field.

Every name and count comes from the snapshot: "Blink's Opacity has three pairs" and "Cut's Opacity has one" match the candidates, "Seal is a precomp" matches left_out, and no times or invented layers appear.

The short turn moves one idea, the intent question "Is anything here meant to snap...?", with the memory line and the required one-sentence Seal note as context; although the Seal note follows the question, the turn still leaves the learner that question to answer.
